# ref 0.2.3

A feature and performance release introducing a lossless graphical `ref.json` editor with crash-safe multi-profile switching, full live configuration hot reload, universal slash and `!` shell completions, manual session startup with detach-to-background in GUI and WebUI, `list_sessions` pagination, and 60fps streaming and split-view polish across all three interfaces.

## Before you update

- **Protocol version 5.** `ref-server`, `ref`, `ref-gui`, and `ref-web` now speak wire protocol v5 (`ReloadConfig`, `GetConfigFiles` / `SaveConfigFile` / `CreateConfigFile` / `SelectConfigFile` / `DeleteConfigFile`, `ListBinaries`, `ListDirs` file and per-session `cwd` support, and `ConfigChanged` broadcasts). Update all binaries together and restart any running `0.2.2` `ref-server` (`ref-server --stop` works across protocol versions; a local `ref-server` started automatically by a client exits once all old client windows close).

## Graphical Configuration Editor & Multi-Profile Management (`ref-gui` & `ref-web`)

- **Visual & JSONC editor (`/config`).** Open from `/config` (`/configuration`), Command Palette → *Configuration*, the sidebar footer button, or *Settings* → *Edit ref.json…*. The 860 px dialog provides both raw JSONC editing and six structured visual sections — *General*, *Providers & Models* (provider presets, nested models, variants, and request options), *Agents* (built-in overrides with reset plus custom agents), *Permissions & Delays* (ordered glob/pattern rules and tool-delay tables), *MCP Servers* (local stdio and remote HTTP), and *Commands & Skills* — with `Ctrl+S` (`Cmd+S` on macOS) save and unsaved-edit confirmation guards.
- **Lossless JSON patching & secret safety.** Visual edits patch the raw unexpanded JSON object in place so untouched keys, `extraBody`, and `{env:VAR}` / `{file:...}` placeholders remain intact. Secret fields mask literal API keys (`•••`) with a show/hide toggle while keeping `{env:VAR}` and `{file:...}` visible in plain text alongside live `{VAR} set` / `{VAR} unset` badges (never exposing expanded secret values), and display override banners when `ref.jsonc`, `$REF_CONFIG` / `$OPENCODE_CONFIG`, or project-level config files take precedence over `ref.json`.
- **Crash-safe multi-profile rotation.** Manage active `ref.json` and numbered `ref.json.<n>.bak` profiles in `~/.config/ref/` with optional top-level `"$name"` labels. Mutations are serialized on `ref-server` and written via sibling `.tmp.json` + `fsync` + atomic rename (`0700` directory / `0600` files on Unix) so no crash point loses a profile; incomplete `*.tmp.json` regular files are cleaned up on server startup.

## Full Hot Configuration Reload (`ref-server`, TUI, GUI, WebUI)

- **Live session & MCP reconciliation.** `/reload` (`/reload-config`) on any client — as well as saving, creating, switching, or deleting profiles in `/config` — reloads configuration without restarting `ref-server`: tracks explicit vs. default session models (`model_explicit`), falls back removed agents, models, or variants, recalculates context window limits, refreshes system prompts on the next step without interrupting in-flight turns, reconciles MCP servers (retrying failed servers and closing removed, disabled, or modified ones without leaking stdio child processes), and broadcasts `ConfigChanged` (with non-fatal warnings) to all connected clients.

## Universal Completions, Slash Guards & `!` Shell Mode (TUI, GUI, WebUI)

- **Slash argument completions, aliases & typo guard.** Added singular aliases `/model` and `/agent`, direct arguments on `/models <m>`, `/agents <a>`, `/variant <v|default>`, `/sessions <s>`, and `/close-session <s…>`, an interactive `/cd` directory picker in TUI, direct dialog routing from `Ctrl+P` in GUI and WebUI (`Esc` in custom-command argument prompts returns to the command list), mid-text `/` completion after whitespace in GUI and WebUI, standalone slash completion without a trailing space on `Tab` with direct execution on `Enter` (keeping a space only on `/rename `), and argument completions across `/cd`, `/export`, `/models`, `/agents`, `/variant`, `/sessions`, `/close-session`, `/mcp` (TUI), and `@file` in custom command arguments. Unknown single-word `/foo` inputs are blocked from sending as LLM prompts with a warning toast and closest-command suggestion.
- **`!` shell mode completions.** Command tokens (at line start, after `|`, `&&`, `||`, `;`, or after `VAR=val` assignments and command wrappers such as `sudo`, `doas`, `env`, `nice`, `ionice`, `timeout`, `chrt`, `taskset`, `xargs`, etc., including path-prefixed binaries and short-flag clusters) complete from `!` prompt history (at line start) and `$PATH` executables (including `PATHEXT` on Windows), or paths when typing `/`, `\`, `.`, `~`, or Windows drive letters; argument tokens complete files and directories in the session directory with `Tab` directory drill-down and a zero-flicker parent-directory cache. In shell mode, `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` never cycle the agent, `↑` / `↓` filter to `!` history entries, and `Enter` in `/cd`, `/export`, and `!` shell mode runs typed text as-is unless a completion was explicitly selected with `↑` / `↓`.

## Manual Session Startup & Detach-to-Background (`ref-gui` & `ref-web`)

- **No auto-created blank session on startup or close.** Starting `ref-gui` (without `-c` / `--continue` or `-s` / `--session`) or opening `ref-web` (without `?session=<id>`), as well as closing the last open session, now lands on the empty workspace state (*No session open*) with *New session in folder…* and *New session* (`DIR`, `--agent`, and `--model` set defaults for manual creation, creating a session in a folder updates the workspace default `cwd`, and `ref-gui --smoke` prints `ready` when no session flag is passed).
- **Move open session to background (`detachCurrent`).** Clicking the already-open session row in *Running* (in single view), choosing *Move to background* from its context menu, or running `/detach` (`/background`, `/leave`) detaches the session to the background (`attached: 0`) without stopping it.

## UI, 60fps Performance, Split View & Tooling

- **Removed artificial bottom blank space.** Removed the `25%` `heldSpace` / `Hold` bottom spacer across GUI (`ChatView.qml`), WebUI (`ChatView.vue`), and TUI (`chat.rs`), keeping only sticky-header fold compensation (`holdHeader`) in GUI and WebUI.
- **Desktop GUI streaming, tables & UX polish.** Added dedicated `TableBlock` cards (`TableSplitter` + independent cell `ProseText` so table selection stays glitch-free and wide tables scroll horizontally), atomic `[Image N]` placeholder cursor/selection/deletion, a Canvas-rendered `ShimmerText` sweep that works across Software and GPU backends, `Ctrl+T` (`Cmd+T`) model variant cycling, collapsible *Todo*, *Running*, and *History* sidebar sections (`todoExpanded` / `runningExpanded` / `historyExpanded` saved to `gui.json`) with a non-oscillating draggable resizable sidebar (210–480 px, double-click reset), blur-fade transitions during split-tile width resizes, non-focusing *Jump to latest* clicks on unfocused split tiles, fixed `PickList` / `CompletionPopup` hover coordinates on scrolled lists, removed `grabToImage` session-switch stalls and eager `Composer` / `Lightbox` instantiations, tightened `ChatView` cache margins (`2400` / `800` px) with immediate split-tile sync, wired `Ctrl+Shift+R` reasoning fold toggle, and added busy-session close confirmation on sidebar and dialog close actions.
- **WebUI collapsible sidebar sections, transitions & reduced motion.** Added collapsible *Todo*, *Running*, and *History* sidebar sections (`sidebarTodoExpanded` / `sidebarRunningExpanded` / `sidebarHistoryExpanded` saved to `localStorage`) with dynamic vertical space redistribution and a draggable resizable sidebar on wide windows (210–480 px, double-click reset), polished `SplitView` enter/leave/zoom transitions and scroll compensation, added in-place `DialogHost` crossfades, stationary-pointer hover guards, reconnect/cwd/MCP configuration sync, and full `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` support.
- **TUI split view, watch-mode completions & selection.** Replaced dashed/double split borders with solid rounded borders (`╭─╮│╰─╯`), tinted unfocused sub-session borders and `⟲ <root>` chips with a deterministic 8-color root-task palette, highlighted tiles with pending `question` calls in `WARNING`, added full `/`, `@`, and `!` shell-mode autocompletion and mouse-drag transcript selection + copy inside split-view watch tiles, and fixed tiny-terminal (`< 6×4`) underflows, `[Image N]` cursor atomicity, single-line horizontal input scrolling, dialog scrollbars, `HelpDialog` navigation keys, and SSH OSC52 copy toasts.
- **`list_sessions` pagination.** Added optional `page` (`>= 1`, default `1`) and `page_size` (`1..=100`, default `50`) parameters, matched `creator` against full session history before slicing, and capped sanitized single-line titles at 80 characters.

## Verification & Known Risks

- **Local verification suites:** Rust workspace tests and clippy on Linux, Web `pnpm check` and `pnpm build`, and GUI Release + ASan/UBSan `ctest` suites under `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen` (including `ref-gui_qmllint`).
- **Unverified before tag CI / desktop smoke:** Native macOS and Windows desktop windowing, IME, and DPI behavior, and 6-target release packaging archives (`release.yml` and `scripts/verify-gui-package.sh` run on tag push).

# ref 0.2.3（简体中文）

0.2.3 是功能与性能增强版本，新增支持防崩溃多方案切换的无损图形化 `ref.json` 配置编辑器、全量实时配置热重载、全端斜杠参数与 `!` Shell 补全、GUI 与 WebUI 手动创建会话及挂到后台模式、`list_sessions` 分页，以及三端 60fps 流式渲染与分屏交互打磨。

## 更新前请注意

- **通信协议升至第 5 版。** `ref-server`、`ref`、`ref-gui` 与 `ref-web` 现使用第 5 版协议（新增 `ReloadConfig`、`GetConfigFiles` / `SaveConfigFile` / `CreateConfigFile` / `SelectConfigFile` / `DeleteConfigFile`、`ListBinaries`、`ListDirs` 文件与按会话 `cwd` 支持，以及 `ConfigChanged` 广播）。升级时请一并更新全部二进制文件，并重启运行中的 `0.2.2` 版 `ref-server`（`ref-server --stop` 支持跨协议版本执行；由客户端自动拉起的本地 `ref-server` 会在旧版窗口全部关闭后自动退出）。

## 图形化配置编辑器与多方案管理（`ref-gui` 与 `ref-web`）

- **可视化与 JSONC 双模式编辑器（`/config`）。** 可通过 `/config`（`/configuration`）、命令面板 → *配置*、侧边栏底部配置按钮或*设置* → *编辑 ref.json…* 打开。860 px 宽的对话框同时提供原始 JSONC 文本编辑与六个结构化可视化分区——*通用*、*提供商与模型*（内置预设、嵌套模型、变体与请求选项）、*智能体*（内置覆盖与重置、自定义智能体）、*权限与延迟*（有序 glob/模式规则表与工具延迟表）、*MCP 服务器*（本地 stdio 与远程 HTTP）以及*命令与技能*——支持 `Ctrl+S`（macOS 上为 `Cmd+S`）保存及未保存修改防丢确认。
- **无损 JSON 补丁与密钥保护。** 可视化修改直接在未展开的原始 JSON 对象上打补丁，未触碰的键、`extraBody` 以及 `{env:VAR}` / `{file:...}` 占位符均原样保留。密钥输入框对明文密钥做掩码处理（`•••`）并提供显示/隐藏切换，同时保持 `{env:VAR}` 与 `{file:...}` 明文可见并实时显示 `{VAR} 已设置` / `{VAR} 未设置` 状态徽标（绝不向前端暴露展开后的密钥值）；当 `ref.jsonc`、`$REF_CONFIG` / `$OPENCODE_CONFIG` 或项目级配置覆盖 `ref.json` 时顶部会显示提示横幅。
- **防崩溃多方案轮转。** 在 `~/.config/ref/` 下管理当前 `ref.json` 与编号备份方案 `ref.json.<n>.bak`，支持可选顶层 `"$name"` 方案标签。所有写入在 `ref-server` 串行执行，采用同目录 `.tmp.json` 临时文件 + `fsync` + 原子重命名（Unix 下目录 `0700`、文件 `0600`），确保任何崩溃点都不会丢失方案；`ref-server` 启动时自动清理残留的 `*.tmp.json` 普通文件。

## 全量配置热重载（`ref-server`、TUI、GUI、WebUI）

- **运行中会话与 MCP 实时对账。** 在任意客户端执行 `/reload`（`/reload-config`），或在 `/config` 中保存、新建、切换、删除配置方案，均无需重启 `ref-server` 即可热重载配置：区分显式固定模型与默认模型（`model_explicit`），在智能体、模型或变体被移除时自动回退，重新计算上下文窗口上限，在下一步刷新系统提示词而不打断正在执行的步骤，同步对账 MCP 服务器（重试此前连接失败的服务器，并关闭已移除、已禁用或配置变更的服务器，不泄漏 stdio 子进程），并向所有已连接客户端广播 `ConfigChanged`（含非致命配置警告）。

## 全局补全、斜杠防误发与 `!` Shell 模式（TUI、GUI、WebUI）

- **斜杠参数补全、别名与拼写防误发。** 新增单数别名 `/model` 与 `/agent`，支持 `/models <m>`、`/agents <a>`、`/variant <v|default>`、`/sessions <s>`、`/close-session <s…>` 直接带参执行，新增 TUI 无参 `/cd` 交互式目录选择器以及 GUI / WebUI 命令面板直达专用对话框（自定义命令参数输入页按 `Esc` 返回命令列表），支持 GUI 与 WebUI 光标位于文本中部空白后的 `/` 补全、可单独运行斜杠命令按 `Tab` 补全不追加空格并按 `Enter` 直接执行（仅 `/rename ` 保留空格），并为 `/cd`、`/export`、`/models`、`/agents`、`/variant`、`/sessions`、`/close-session`、`/mcp`（TUI）及自定义命令中的 `@file` 提供参数补全。未知的单个斜杠词 `/foo` 会被拦截并弹出警告与最接近的命令建议，防止误发给 LLM。
- **`!` Shell 模式补全。** 命令词（行首、`|`、`&&`、`||`、`;` 之后，或 `VAR=val` 赋值与 `sudo`、`doas`、`env`、`nice`、`ionice`、`timeout`、`chrt`、`taskset`、`xargs` 等包装命令及其路径前缀/组合短参数之后）合并补全 `!` 提示历史（仅行首）与 `$PATH` 可执行程序（含 Windows `PATHEXT`），输入 `/`、`\`、`.`、`~` 或盘符时自动切换为路径补全；参数词补全会话目录下的文件与目录，支持按 `Tab` 逐级进入子目录及无闪烁父目录缓存。Shell 模式下 `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` 不再误触发智能体切换，`↑` / `↓` 仅筛选 `!` 历史记录；在 `/cd`、`/export` 与 `!` Shell 模式下，除非已用 `↑` / `↓` 显式选中补全项，否则按 `Enter` 直接执行输入原文。

## 手动创建会话与挂到后台（`ref-gui` 与 `ref-web`）

- **启动与关闭不再自动新建空白会话。** 启动 `ref-gui`（未传 `-c` / `--continue` 或 `-s` / `--session`）、打开 `ref-web`（未带 `?session=<id>`）或关闭最后一个打开的会话时，现在进入空白工作区（*未打开会话*），提供*选择文件夹新建会话…*与*新建会话*（`DIR`、`--agent`、`--model` 作为手动新建会话的默认值，选择文件夹新建会话会同步更新工作区默认 `cwd`，`ref-gui --smoke` 在未传会话参数时输出 `ready`）。
- **将已打开会话挂到后台（`detachCurrent`）。** 在单会话视图下再次点击侧栏*运行中*里当前打开的会话、在右键菜单选择*挂到后台*，或执行 `/detach`（`/background`、`/leave`），即可在不停止会话运行的情况下将其转为后台状态（`attached: 0`）。

## 界面、60fps 性能、分屏打磨与工具改进

- **移除对话底部人为留白。** 移除 GUI（`ChatView.qml`）、WebUI（`ChatView.vue`）与 TUI（`chat.rs`）中最高 `25%` 视口高度的 `heldSpace` / `Hold` 底部空白占位，仅保留 GUI 与 WebUI 吸顶块折叠时的滚动锚定补偿（`holdHeader`）。
- **桌面 GUI 流式渲染、表格与交互打磨。** 新增独立 `TableBlock` 表格卡片（`TableSplitter` + 单元格独立 `ProseText`，彻底解决表内选中文字导致上方行渲染异常，支持宽表格横向滚动与悬停复制）、`[Image N]` 图片令牌原子光标/选区/整枚删除、在软件与 GPU 渲染器下均稳定可见的 Canvas `ShimmerText` 渐变扫描动画、`Ctrl+T`（`Cmd+T`）快速切换模型变体、可折叠/展开的侧栏*待办*/*运行中*/*历史*分区（`todoExpanded` / `runningExpanded` / `historyExpanded` 持久化到 `gui.json`）及无抖动可拖拽调节侧边栏宽度（210–480 px、双击还原）、分屏窗口缩放时的模糊渐隐/渐显过渡、未聚焦分块点击*跳到最新*不再误打开输入框，并修复滚动后 `PickList` / `CompletionPopup` 悬停坐标偏移、移除切会话时的 `grabToImage` 停顿与预加载开销、收紧 `ChatView` 缓存边距（`2400` / `800` px）并立即同步分屏分块、接通 `Ctrl+Shift+R` 思考折叠快捷键，为侧栏与会话弹窗关闭按钮补齐忙碌会话确认提示。
- **WebUI 侧边栏折叠与调宽、过渡动画及减弱动态支持。** 新增可折叠/展开的侧栏*待办*/*运行中*/*历史*分区（`sidebarTodoExpanded` / `sidebarRunningExpanded` / `sidebarHistoryExpanded` 持久化到 `localStorage`，动态分配其余展开分区高度）与宽屏下可拖拽调节左侧栏宽度（210–480 px、双击还原），打磨 `SplitView` 进出与缩放过渡及滚动位置补偿，支持 `DialogHost` 原地交叉淡入淡出、静止鼠标悬停防护、重连/目录切换/MCP 配置状态同步，以及完整的 `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` 支持。
- **TUI 分屏、后台模式补全与文本选择。** 分屏边框统一改为实线圆角边框（`╭─╮│╰─╯`），使用固定 8 色根任务调色板为未聚焦子会话边框与 `⟲ <根会话>` 标签着色，待回答 `question` 的分块以 `WARNING` 高亮，为分屏后台模式补齐 `/`、`@`、`!` Shell 补全与鼠标拖拽选中复制，并修复超小终端（`< 6×4`）无符号下溢、单行输入框横向滚动、弹窗滚动条、`HelpDialog` 导航键误关及 SSH OSC52 复制提示。
- **`list_sessions` 分页支持。** 新增可选参数 `page`（`>= 1`，默认 `1`）与 `page_size`（`1..=100`，默认 `50`），在分页切片前针对全量历史执行 `creator` 过滤，并将净化后的单行会话标题截断上限设为 80 个字符。

## 验证与已知风险

- **本地验证套件：** Linux 下 Rust 工作区测试与 clippy、Web `pnpm check` 与 `pnpm build`，以及 GUI Release 与 ASan/UBSan 构建下的 `ctest`（`QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen`，含 `ref-gui_qmllint`）。
- **待标签 CI / 真机验证项：** macOS 与 Windows 原生桌面窗口、输入法与高分屏表现，以及 6 个目标平台的发布安装包产物（将在推送标签时由 `release.yml` 与 `scripts/verify-gui-package.sh` 执行验证）。
